pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometry with jagged, leaf-like edge gradients and deep indentations. The spatial area of the patches is roughly equivalent to the area of the surrounding light-colored corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space forms a wide, continuous mesh of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are prominent and wide, especially at the intersection of three or more corridors on the mid-flank and lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck line presents as a dark, short-haired silhouette with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian ectoparasite cleaners (oxpeckers) attached to the specimen: one on the mid-dorsal neck and one on the lower neck/brisket region.
